scientific_integrity.proved_scope: Global radial convergence, exact block inverse-square logarithmic asymptotic, phase-resolved leading terms, and sharp permutation extremizers for all finite critical switching words.
scientific_integrity.unproved: No extension to stochastic forcing, complex starting states, or physical measures on the full circle.

scientific_limitations: Exact product-one periodic switching and real radial starts only; no iid or complex-plane rate theorem; logarithmic expansion mechanism has established parabolic precedents; independent priority check is outstanding.
title: Optimal ordering and exact critical relaxation in periodic Blaschke switching
